records.title: Ripple Prime disclosure: Hidden Road Partners CIV US LLC is a registered FCM
records.note: Ripple's official FCM-specific disclosure identifies Hidden Road Partners CIV US LLC as a registered futures commission merchant and also an SEC/FINRA-registered broker-dealer. The exact same legal-entity name appears in Bitnomial Clearinghouse's current clearing-member list. Ripple separately states the Hidden Road acquisition closed and Hidden Road is now Ripple Prime. This establishes a direct legal-entity/clearing-member connection; it does not establish Letter 26-05 reliance, XRP collateral deposits, customer balances or utilization.

records.title: Reuters Coinbase Q3 2026: prediction markets, derivatives and revenue diversification
records.note: Reuters reports prediction-market revenue exceeded $200M on an annualized run-rate basis; prediction markets plus derivatives accounted for about 25% of Q3 transaction revenue; subscription/services were about 49% of net revenue. These are run-rate/mix measures, not realized XRP trading or settlement flows. Coinbase's transaction revenue still fell 43% year-over-year to $590.2M; GAAP profit was helped by crypto-investment gains.
